visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room. A young toddler with blonde hair, wearing a white long-sleeve shirt and green striped pants, moves excitedly towards the camera with a wide, toothy grin. A man in a dark shirt is behind him, partially visible as he assists the child. In the background, there is a modern white bookshelf and a grey stone fireplace. The child is later seen lying on a beige carpet next to a calico cat and a small green wooden toy. (2) The setting transitions to a sunlit outdoor park area. The toddler, now wearing a tropical-themed short-sleeve shirt and matching shorts with white clogs, is being held high in the air by a woman in a white dress. They are standing near yellow metal bars, with lush green trees and residential buildings in the background. The child laughs and looks up with squinted eyes. Later, the child is seen running independently along a stone path, smiling and looking around at the environment as the camera follows his movement.

It aims to evoke nostalgia and warmth through high-contrast settings and a thematic soundtrack.
